authority.scope: explicit tenant, binding, membership, action, organization and exact nullable sector

definition.validity: explicit inclusive validFrom/validUntil; no default dates
definition.deviceIds: explicit nonempty exhaustive declaration from inventory022
definition.complete: declared completeness for this contract's devices, not area-population or period coverage
definition.subjectVersion: SHA-256 of the complete stable history result in PostgreSQL jsonb text

history: immutable proposal, independent decision and explicitly dated retirement; earlier validity retained
labels: area/sector from authorized catalogue, contract from proved canonical identity, devices from technical inventory
partialPopulation: proved individual members may be declared while whole-area conclusions remain blocked
recovery: same body, key, verified person, membership, tenant, binding, session and scope; no uncertain retry under another identity
